text:
Jordan: Morning — async check-in:
• Pipeline: Fenix deal proposal sent, waiting legal (EOD) ; MacroHealth follow-up scheduled for 2pm PT.
• Blockers: MacroHealth asked for network diagram + SOC2 excerpts. Need security input.
• Today: triage MacroHealth asks, prep demo for Fenix, clear backlog PRs.

Priya (AE): Fenix — legal reviewing licensing; asked for a usage cap clause. I can push for tomorrow. MacroHealth — asked very specific KMS question (HSM vs cloud KMS).

Alex (SE): I can assemble the network diagram by noon. Also pinged infra for sample VPC peering notes.

Maya (Security): @Priya quick note — we can confirm cloud KMS w/ customer-managed keys; HSM is only in Private deployments. I'll attach SOC2 excerpts in thread.

Diego (Account Exec): MacroHealth timeline is tight — they want compliance artefacts before Friday. If security needs anything from procurement/legal, flag it now.

Jordan: Thx. @Maya can you drop the SOC2 snippet and a short line we can paste into the SOW? (one-liner about data scope)

Maya (Security): Paste for SOW: "Redwood Inference processes only customer-specified request data; control plane logs are retained per contract; SOC2 Type II report available upon NDA." Will DM full report link.

Sam (Eng): FYI — Demo infra has an intermittent tokenization bug in quantized model path. Not a blocker for Fenix demo (using hosted model) but I filed #4321. Will aim to have fix in tomorrow's patch.

Priya (AE): Good call @Sam — let me know if I should switch demo model. Also, @Alex if you can drop the VPC diagram, I'll forward to MacroHealth with Maya's SOW line.

Alex (SE): Diagram attached (uploaded). Also adding the VPC peering notes snippet:
```
VPC peering: customer -> redwood-vpc (shared VPC). Use CIDR 10.0.0.0/16. Ensure route to redwood-inference-gw.
TLS: mTLS required for Private connections.
```

Maya (Security): Received. Small FYI: MacroHealth asked about key rotation cadence — we recommend 90 days for CMK rotation; can state that in docs.

Jordan: OK — action items: @Alex finalize diagram + notes (done), @Maya drop SOC2 + rotation cadence (done), @Priya send artifacts to MacroHealth and sync EOD. Any last blockers?

Diego (Account Exec): No further blockers from my side. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Thanks team — will mark this thread resolved after MacroHealth confirms. :white_check_mark:
